name: framework-data-ai
description: One plugin: the Data & AI documentation framework. This repository is its own marketplace, so `claude plugin marketplace add <path-or-repo>` is the whole distribution mechanism. Adding a local path installs nothing anywhere else.

plugins.name: framework-data-ai
